reason: Nobody in our kindergarten Telegram group has talked about Kiddo, so I would maybe put the free version on my phone and see if my son actually learns letters or just taps the mascot. I'm not paying for PRO for an app no other mother has vouched for.
objection: Will my child really learn the Uzbek letters and numbers, or is it just another game that keeps him busy? I don't know these people and I don't know if PRO gives anything the free part doesn't.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three mothers in our kindergarten group saying their child started reading letters with it and that PRO was worth it.
